cost.fallback-metric: parent-session elapsed observation; cost not host-observable in this arm

acceptance: `wordstats count <path> --stats` appends a summary object (min, max, median, unique) after the counts object; default output without the option is unchanged.
The summary logic lives in new module `src/wordstats/stats.py`; the option is integrated in `src/wordstats/cli.py`.

The `stats.py` module and its focused unit tests are implemented by a delegated child worker whose child task record (`src/wordstats/as-is.json` + `src/wordstats/tasks.md`) budgets at most $0.02 and 180 seconds; the child record is the record of authority for the delegation and the launcher registry is mechanical evidence only.
If the child stops on budget, the stop is recorded as a result per the recovery contract, the remaining work is completed from the parent, and the child is not re-rolled.
Focused unit tests cover the summary values (min, max, median, unique) and the `--stats` option.
Design note recorded before implementation; ownership map covers all changed areas.
